title: Proved on a net with no bound
text: The transition `produce` puts a new token in `queue` every time it fires, so the net has infinitely many reachable markings and no enumeration of them can finish; the Lean reference stops at its cap. The verifier still proves both properties: the linear bound `busyA + busyB + lock ≤ 1` keeps the two workers apart, and after its own enumeration stops at 50 000 classes, Commoner's theorem gives deadlock freedom, since every siphon contains an initially marked trap.

steps.text: The transition `produce` keeps its `source` token and adds one to `queue`.
And again: `queue` can grow without limit.
Worker A takes a job and the lock.
A job waits, but `lock` is empty: B cannot start while A is busy.
